module_summary: DarkRISCV SoC top: a darkbridge-wrapped core drives an X-bus whose address bits [31:30] decode chip selects for BRAM, I/O, SDRAM/stub and unmapped regions, muxing back read data and acks.

anchors.name: XDREQ
anchors.why: Core data-bus request from bridge0, gated per region into XDREQMUX.

anchors.name: XADDR
anchors.why: Core data-bus address; bits [31:30] select the target slave.

anchors.name: XATAO
anchors.why: Core write data broadcast to BRAM, I/O and SDRAM slaves.

anchors.name: XDREQMUX
anchors.why: Address-decoded per-slave request selects: BRAM, I/O, SDRAM, unmapped.

anchors.name: XATAIMUX
anchors.why: Per-slave read data array, indexed by XADDR[31:30] back to core.

anchors.name: XDACKMUX
anchors.why: Per-slave ack array selected by XADDR[31:30] for the core.

anchors.name: XWR
anchors.why: Write strobe from core to BRAM and I/O slaves.

anchors.name: XRD
anchors.why: Read strobe from core to BRAM and I/O slaves.

anchors.name: XBE
anchors.why: Byte enables for slave writes.

anchors.name: HLT
anchors.why: Core halt from bridge stalling on pending requests; fed to BRAM and I/O.

anchors.name: IADDR
anchors.why: Harvard instruction address from bridge to BRAM instruction port.

anchors.name: IDATA
anchors.why: Instruction word returned from BRAM to the core.

anchors.name: XIRQ
anchors.why: Timer interrupt from io0 to the core bridge.

anchors.name: DTACK2
anchors.why: Wait-state counter acking unmapped SDRAM region accesses.

anchors.name: DTACK3
anchors.why: Wait-state counter acking unmapped region 3 accesses.

anchors.name: RES
anchors.why: Internal stretched reset generated from XRES distributed to all blocks.

anchors.name: UART_RXD
anchors.why: UART receive line into io0.

anchors.name: UART_TXD
anchors.why: UART transmit line from io0.

anchors.name: LED
anchors.why: LED register output from io0.

anchors.name: oport
anchors.why: GPIO output from io0 driving OPORT.

anchors.name: iport
anchors.why: GPIO input from IPORT into io0.

groups.name: CPU bridge
groups.description: darkbridge core issuing X-bus data requests and Y-bus instruction fetches.

groups.name: Address decoder and return mux
groups.description: XADDR[31:30] selects slave request and muxes read data/ack.

groups.name: Block RAM
groups.description: Dual-port BRAM for instructions and data at region 0.

groups.name: I/O block
groups.description: darkio UART, GPIO, LED and timer IRQ at region 1.

groups.name: Unmapped region responders
groups.description: Countdown acks returning deadbeef for regions 2 and 3.

groups.name: Clock/reset
groups.description: Reset stretcher/PLL producing CLK and RES.
